title: The Locked Wing
text: A door in the Seat that was never there opens onto a wing that was never built: long corridors, furnished, dusted, lamps lit. The portraits on the walls are of your House. Some of the faces are of Scions not yet born.

outcomes.text: A treasure room, dusty and real.
A nursery, with a child in it who knows your name.
Nothing but corridors that lead back to the door. Some never stop walking them in their sleep.
The bricks are warm for a week.
